info.title: Custom Fields API
info.description: Use this API to retrieve select options for a custom field in your Perk account.

tags.name: Custom fields
tags.description: Retrieve select options for custom fields in your Perk account.

parameters.name: custom_field_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the custom field

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Your Perk API key, using the format 'ApiKey <your_api_key>'

parameters.name: Api-Version
parameters.description: The API version for this request. Must be '1'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of options to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of options to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filters options to those whose value contains this substring.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to include. Accepts 'active' and 'archived'. Defaults to 'active'.

200.description: Returns 200 OK and a list of select options for the custom field, along with total_count, limit and offset

select_options.description: The list of options matching the request

id.description: The unique ID of the select option

is_archived.description: Indicates whether the option is archived

total_count.description: Total number of options matching the filter, across all pages

limit.description: Effective page size used (echoes the request's limit, default 20)

offset.description: Effective offset used (echoes the request's offset, default 0)

400.description: Returns '400 Bad Request' when custom_field_id is missing or not a valid ID, or when limit or offset is out of range.

errors.description: A list of human-readable error messages

errors: limit: Input should be less than or equal to 100

401.description: Returns '401 Unauthorized' when the Authorization header is missing or the API key is invalid. This response has no body.

404.description: Returns '404 Not Found' when custom_field_id doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the account associated with your API key.

errors.description: A list of human-readable error messages

405.description: Returns '405 Method Not Allowed' when the request uses any HTTP method other than GET.

errors.description: A list of human-readable error messages
